open_points.subject: Mapped node output shape (M14, A13 rule 6)
open_points.text: "each output collects one result per element in that order" (M14) and "its outputs are then lists in element order" (A13 rule 6)
open_points.question: When a mapped node’s declared output port is already `many`, does collection produce a nested list (one list per map element) or flatten into one list, and how is that validated against downstream `value_schema`/cardinality?
options: Keep per-element result as-is, so mapped `many` output becomes nested (list of lists / list of file-lists)
Flatten one level when collecting mapped results so output stays single-level `many`
open_points.default_guess: Keep nested per-element results (no implicit flatten), because "collects one result per element" reads as positional collection.

open_points.subject: Surface request size check (A16 rule 1)
open_points.text: "its size, counted as the bytes of the request message as received"
open_points.question: What exact byte sequence is measured for `surface_request_bytes_max` on MCP: transport frame bytes, parsed payload bytes, or canonical re-encoding?
options: Count raw bytes on the wire for the MCP request message envelope+payload
Count only the decoded request payload bytes passed to operation dispatch
Count UTF-8 bytes of the parsed JSON re-serialized in a fixed form
open_points.default_guess: Count the decoded request payload bytes at the MCP boundary before schema validation.

open_points.subject: NodeExecution timestamps for non-executed records (M23, A15, A13)
open_points.text: M23 includes `started_at`, `ended_at`, while A15 requires records also for `skipped_by_guard` and `upstream_failed` nodes and A13 defines synthetic mapped-node records over empty lists.
open_points.question: For records where no execution actually ran (`skipped_by_guard`, `upstream_failed`, mapped empty-list synthetic record), what values must `started_at` and `ended_at` take?
options: Set both to the record-write instant
Set `started_at` to when node first became ready/non-executable and `ended_at` to record-write instant
Allow null/absent timestamps for non-executed statuses
open_points.default_guess: Set both timestamps to the same record-write instant.

open_points.subject: Trial case expected output completeness (A04 rule 1, M06)
open_points.text: "its expected outputs, when present, fit the output ports"
open_points.question: When `expected_outputs` is present, must it contain exactly all output ports (no missing, no extra), or can it be partial?
options: Allow subset of output ports and compare only those
Allow exact set plus ignore unknown keys
open_points.default_guess: Require exact output-port set to match function return contract strictness.
